svg.aria-label: Constructed two-compartment model with fixed intrinsic rates. Equivalent site concentration is 200 or 2 nM; exchange rate is 0.005 or 0.5 per second. A compares occupancy fractions; C normalizes each curve to occupancy at wash onset. Residual local analyte can continue binding during slow exchange.
